title: CommitDigest
description: Shape of digest.json, the commit-digest kit's single deliverable. Mirrors the output of the converted source's build_digest() exactly (ADR-025 parity target) — every field except generated_at is a pure function of the input commit list.

generated_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of the run. The one nondeterministic field — normalized away by the parity harness.

commit_count.description: Total number of commits in the input.

by_type.description: Commit count per conventional-commit-style type (feat, fix, docs, chore, ...).

unique_authors.description: Number of distinct authors in the input.

first_date.description: ISO 8601 date of the earliest commit, or null when the input is empty.

last_date.description: ISO 8601 date of the latest commit, or null when the input is empty.
